title: getAttributeGroupCodeData request
description: Read all groups under a grouping code for one customer. Like getAttributeGroupData but keyed by grouping_code; returns every group under that code as group_list. snake_case body. Errors: E1006 (required param missing), E1001/E1002 (unknown grouping code).

grouping_code.description: The grouping-code id or code string. snake_case.
